{{Top}}
A '''[[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] rocket''' was a small and lethal explosive designed for use with personal weapon systems. This [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] was designed to explode in a roiling ball of super-heated gas on impact, burning everything in the immediate area. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]] was known to use this type of weapon while she traveled with the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]].
